newsitem.title: MEXICO: Carrefour, Gigante to invest $100 mln in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour, Gigante to invest $100 mln in Mexico.

text.p: A retail joint venture benwteen French firm Carrefour Supermarche SA and Mexican partner Gigante SA will invest $100 million this year, the companies said Wednesday.

"We have decided to continue investing in 1997. Carrefour and Gigante have five (new store) projects in the pipeline with an approximate investment total of $100 million," Carrefour's Jean Duboc told a meeting of foreign businessmen and President Ernesto Zedillo.
Currently, the Carrefour-Gigante venture has 13 stores operating that were opened in 1995 and 1996, when Mexico was in the midst of a severe economic recession.
Duboc said the evolution of the economy in the first quarter of this year would "allow companies in Mexico to take long-term decisions."
